description: Poland KNF Financial Registry Scraper. Extract payment institutions, e-money issuers, credit intermediaries, lending companies & pawnbroking operators from 3 Polish KNF registries. Search by name, NIP, entity type. Bulk export 75,000+ entities. Structured JSON. No auth needed. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

entityType.description: Filter by entity type code. e-rup: PSD_PI, PSD_EMI, PSD_ENL, PSD_EPI@BP, PSD_EPI@MIP, PSD_AISP, PSD_AG, PSD_BR. rpkip: RPH, RPK, RHA, RIP. Leave empty for all types.
entityType.title: Entity Type Code

exportAll.description: Export all records from the selected registry. Ignores name/NIP/entityType filters. Use for bulk data extraction.
exportAll.title: Export All Records

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 100. Set to 0 for unlimited (use with Export All for full registry dump).
maxResults.title: Max Results

name.description: Search by entity/company name (partial match, case-insensitive)
name.title: Entity Name

nip.description: Search by Polish Tax Identification Number (NIP) — exact match
nip.title: NIP Number

registry.description: Which KNF registry to search. e-rup = payment/e-money institutions (~17k entities), rpkip = credit intermediaries & lending institutions (~58k entities), rdl = pawnbroking activities (~250 entities), all = search all three.
registry.title: Registry

name: regdata_knf_registry
